commands/.github/prompts

12 files in this folder are published on this site.

  • /clarify - questions before code clarify.prompt.mdSurface ambiguities and silent assumptions before any code is written. Asks at most 5 questions.
  • /deps-check - is every dependency real and needed? deps-check.prompt.mdVerify every import, package, and API member against the manifest, the standard library, or official docs. Never installs anything.
  • /deslop - find the slop before it ships deslop.prompt.mdReview a change for AI-slop patterns (swallowed errors, fake tests, duplicate helpers, debug prints, narrating comments) and report findings only.
  • /fail-paths - test what breaks, not just what works fail-paths.prompt.mdEnumerate edge cases and failure paths, write tests for them, and run them. Never weakens an assertion to get green.
  • /ground - anchor the change in repo truth ground.prompt.mdMap what a change needs to what already exists in the repo, with file:line evidence. Flags invented helpers, config keys, and APIs.
  • /handoff - save the context, then clear it handoff.prompt.mdWrite HANDOFF.md - goal, state, decisions, evidence, open questions, next steps - so a fresh chat can continue without this one.
  • /pre-commit - the last checkpoint pre-commit.prompt.mdFinal gate before a commit - checks scope, debug output, secrets, stubs, skipped tests, and real test results. Ends with READY or NOT READY.
  • /root-cause - fix the defect, not the ticket root-cause.prompt.mdReproduce a bug, test at most 3 hypotheses, and confirm the root cause before any fix. Rejects special-casing the reported input.
  • /scope - contract before change scope.prompt.mdWrite SCOPE.md - a short contract of allowed changes, forbidden paths, frozen API, done-when, and rollback - before any edit.
  • /simplify - less code, same behavior simplify.prompt.mdRemove duplication, dead code, and speculative abstraction without changing behavior. Tests must be green before and after.
  • /spec - define done before code spec.prompt.mdTurn an agreed request into a short, testable spec with acceptance criteria and real verification commands.
  • /verify - evidence, not claims verify.prompt.mdRun the real checks and report only what was observed - command, exit code, result. Ends with VERIFIED or NOT VERIFIED.

Walkthroughs and studio scenes are illustrative, not recorded Copilot output. Only the Commands lab GIFs show real check results, re-run by the recorder before each capture. No productivity statistics are claimed.
